AntiPattern.Bad: `console.log("fetching user " + JSON.stringify({ id }));` then `catch (e) { console.error("failed " + e); throw new Error("fetch failed"); }`.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: `console.*` forbidden (`AX_STRUCTURED_LOGGING`). Object serialized into message string (`AX_LOG_MESSAGE_PURITY`). No Trace-Prefix or state transition (`AX_LOG_MESSAGE_FORMAT`). `new Error` without `{ cause }` loses debug chain (`AX_ERROR_CHAINING_CAUSE`). No Trace-Prefix in error (`AX_TRACE_PREFIXED_ERRORS`). `e` concatenated into string — stack lost.
